rows.en:
(Wait, am I maybe the type
who spoils little sisters?)
Huh?! What's wrong, Pinon-chan?!

I've been drinking my milk like I'm supposed to,
but I'm not getting any taller at all...

...I really don't think you'll grow
that fast, Pinon-chan...
Is that so...?

You don't have to rush. You'll become
a wonderful grown-up woman with
a knockout body, Pinon-chan.
A wonderful woman...

Haaah~~...
Yeah! You're right!
In that case, I'll have to work even harder!

Alright! I'll double the amount of milk
I drink every day!

With this, I'll have a knockout body
in no time...

(Hmm...
I feel like she's putting her effort
in the wrong direction...)
(Well, I guess trying hard is a good thing.)
Go for it, Pinon-chan!

Hehehe, soon I'll be a grown-up woman with
such a knockout body you'll fall for me, nya!!
rows.notes: Pinon, male scene. She means to end with 'na' and slips into 'nya' (next row: she bit her tongue).

rows.en: ...............I bit my tongue.

Affinity ending.
Filler for Pinon (female).

Deep Akihabara on the way home today.)

(Huh?
Is Pinon-chan heading home now too?)

Heyyy, Pinon-chan!
Want to go to Deep Akihabara with me?

Why would I have to go
to Deep Akihabara with you?

W-well, I just thought it'd be fun
if we went together...
rows.notes: x8, the player in frd_pnn_101/102, both genders.

rows.en:
I, for one, have no business
in Deep Akihabara. I'll have to decline.

(Sigh... Pinon-chan turned me down.
Oh well, guess I'll go to Deep Akihabara alone.)

at least. I'll have to decline.

Oh well, guess I'll go see a movie alone.)

Want to go see a movie with me?

(Let's see... Maybe I'll stop by
Silver Moon on the way home today.)

(Oh, Pinon-chan...
I know, I'll try inviting her too.)

rows.en:
Pinon-chan, want to stop by
Silver Moon on the way home?

Hmm, planning to snack on the way home again,
\p?
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. 'snack on the way home' for kaigui as in slices 163-164.

rows.en:
Yep.
But it's fine as long as Pinon-sensei
is with me, right?
rows.notes: Player, both genders; callback to Pinon allowing it when a teacher comes along.

rows.en:
Well, that's true, but...
I've got something to take care of now.

Oh, I see...
That's too bad.

I can't today, but when I'm free,
I suppose I could go with you.
Then I'll invite you again some other time.
Mm, see you.
rows.notes: x12: Pinon here (frd_pnn_103/104) and Klan in nml_kln_016/019, both genders. 'Mm' as the existing 'umu' (c07760).

rows.en:

on the way home, so I guess I'll just
head straight home today.)

Oh, I see...
That's too bad.

Pinon-chan, want to stop by

(I came to the Observation Pier with
Pinon-chan after school today, but...)

(We haven't said a word to each other
for a while now...)
Wh-what is it, Pinon-chan?
rows.notes: x8, the player, frd_pnn_105/106, both genders.

rows.en:
...Now that I'm here, the Observation Pier
is quite an interesting place.
Oh... Y-yeah, it is.

(I see, Pinon-chan was quiet because
she was busy taking in the view.)

Yeah...
I'm glad you brought me here today.

I should be thanking you.
I'm glad you enjoyed it, Pinon-chan.

R-really...?
Then when I'm free, I suppose
I could come along again.
So invite me again...
Haha, yeah, I'll do that.
